items.title: resolveCreationTarget + note-list.ts newNote 接入
evidence: state.ts:resolveCreationTarget() added (fallback chain: explicit folder > currentNote.folder_id in 'all' view > null). note-list.ts:newNote 改为调用 resolveCreationTarget().

items.title: import-ui.ts 复用 resolveCreationTarget
evidence: import-ui.ts 拖拽/选择导入路径改为 resolveCreationTarget(),与 newNote 共享同一 fallback,DRY 达成。

items.title: editor.ts 新增 search-highlight 模块 + clearSearchHighlights API
evidence: editor.ts 新增 searchHighlightField (StateField+Decoration), applySearchHighlight()/clearSearchHighlights() exports; on('currentNote') 回调后调用;renderPreview 内若 searchQuery 在则 markPreviewHits;MAX_HITS=200, MIN_QUERY_LEN=2 防御。

items.title: index.ts runSearch auto-select + 监听清空 searchQuery 调清高亮
evidence: index.ts runSearch:命中非空时若 currentNote 与第一条不同则 dispatch note:select 自动打开,相同则直接 applySearchHighlight;零命中时 clearSearchHighlights;q 变空时 clearSearchHighlights。

items.title: global.css 加 .cm-search-hit / mark.preview-hit 样式(light/dark)
evidence: global.css 新增 .cm-search-hit 和 .prose mark.preview-hit 样式,light/dark 两套配色,与 .note-excerpt mark 同色系。

items.title: npm run build 构建验证
evidence: npm run build 通过:163 modules transformed, vite v5.4.21 built in 2.99s,无 TS error;chunk size warning 系既有(main 797kB),与本次改动无关。
